title: Dispatch the courier
story: MARA's courier, Mica, carries a fuse. Its rail runs east to the first airlock.
objective: Return RIGHT once per column between start and goal. Coordinates are [x, y].
lesson: A route is a list of step names. Multiplying a list repeats its elements. A zero-length trip needs an empty list.
hint: Subtract start[0] from goal[0] to get the number of moves.
